traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report covers multiple studies (initial validation on PikoReal, 7500 Fast and QS5 instruments; plus extension studies in 2022/2025/2026 with additional categories and SureClean variants). I selected the initial validation study's method comparison table for the 7500 Fast PCR instrument (Table 13, page 5/6) as the primary/canonical per-category results, since it is the main sensitivity study table with per-category breakdown (categories ❶-❻: Multi-components foods, Meat products, Dairy products, Seafood and fishery products, Vegetables, Environmental samples). Equivalent per-category tables also exist for PikoReal and QS5 instruments (Table 14) with slightly different values, and for the extension study (Tables 61/62) with different/additional categories (Composite foods, Dairy products 125g, Multi-component foods 125g, Powder Infant Formula and Dairy products 25g with/without SureClean) - these were not included per instructions to report only the primary/canonical study. 'Total' rows per category and 'All categories' summary rows were excluded as instructed. Table 15 gives overall (All categories) summary figures for PikoReal/7500 Fast/QS5 but these are aggregate, not per-category, so not recorded in the qualitative array.
